description: Consommation d'électricité des entreprises et collectivités locales dans les régions françaises non interconnectées is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Eco CO2. The SECNIR dataset (Survey of Electric Consumption in Non-Interconnected Regions) gathers electricity consumption data from 881 companies and local authorities located in the French overseas regions and Corsica. This dataset provides detailed information on electricity consumption from individual meters of companies and local authorities in tropical and Mediterranean regions between 2021 and 2024. Coverage: Eco CO2. The portal shows the English title as "Electricity consumption of businesses and local authorities in non-interconnected French regions" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Eco CO2. Its keywords include donnees-ouvertes, sensibilite-thermique, compteurs-intelligents, regions-non-interconnectees, electricite, energie. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2024-09-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by-sa). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
